correctness.rationale: Eliminating both randomized stage equations gives R_s(u)=1-s/(1+su). The push-forward density (1-r)^-2 on [1-s,1/(1+s)] integrates to 1. Its moving-endpoint differentiation gives Fp'= (|1-s|^p-(1+s)^(-p))/s^2 with unique minimizer sqrt(2). The p<1 large-s beta integral is pi*p/sin(pi*p)>1; for p>=1 Fatou gives divergence, yielding a unique >2 crossing. Strict Lyapunov/power-mean ordering gives s_p decreasing. Uniform log-moment expansion at small p and endpoint Laplace at large p yield the stated asymptotics; independently computed thresholds for p=.5,1,2,4: 11.22032689545,6.21826223760,4.03361046936,3.03345683307. Finite quadrature corroborates, not proves, all-p statements.
